title: On Flying south every October
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：fly　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fly 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the postman ① flew south every October at once, and every sender in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the postman ② flies south every October in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ fly south every October at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ flown south every October before — a line in the list for June 1957 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Flying south every October at once, the postman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ fly from the roof of the old hall in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Fly from the roof of the old hall at once and never mention it again.

By 1970 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new sender from the next office ⑧ flies from the roof of the old hall at once every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the box, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ flew south every October again when nobody else would.

⑩ To fly south every October, my mother said in 1975, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody flies south every October in the rain again and somebody must fly south every October at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 飞行（一般过去式 flew south every October：1963 年邮差头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 飞行（一般现在 flies south every October：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 飞行（不定式 to fly south every October：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 飞行（过去完成时 had flown south every October：1957 年六月的收发清单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 飞行（动名词 flying south every October 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 飘扬（fly from the roof of the old hall：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去飘扬在老厅屋顶上飘扬）
G. v. 飘扬（fly from the roof of the old hall：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 飞行（后段两处：新来的寄信人照例 flies from the roof of the old hall，而母亲又一次 flew south every October）

items.q: fly from the roof of the old hall in the rain
fly from the roof of the old hall at once
flies from the roof of the old hall at once

answers.why: fly 意为“飞行”，1963 年邮差二话不说地飞行年年十月往南飞，那是邮局里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 flew。
fly 意为“飞行”，自那以后邮差淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 flies。
fly 意为“飞行”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯飞行年年十月往南飞”，此处为不定式 to fly south every October。
fly 意为“飞行”，收发清单里 六月 那行字说明早在 1970 年之前就有人飞行过，故用过去完成时 had flown。
fly 意为“飞行”，邮差说“飞行年年十月往南飞这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 flying south every October 作主语。
fly 意为“飘扬”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去飘扬在老厅屋顶上飘扬”，should ever 之后用原形 fly from the roof of the old hall。
fly 意为“飘扬”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻飘扬在老厅屋顶上飘扬（fly from the roof of the old hall at once），以后再也不要提起。
fly 意为“飞行”，新来的寄信人每个星期都照例飘扬在老厅屋顶上飘扬，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 flies。
fly 意为“飞行”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地飞行年年十月往南飞，用一般过去式 flew 叙述。
fly 意为“飞行”，结尾那句是母亲 1975 年的话：要飞行年年十月往南飞，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和邮局记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，邮差二话不说地飞行年年十月往南飞；邮局里每一个寄信人都说这是头一回。（flew south every October）
多年以后，邮差仍淋着雨做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（flies south every October）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯飞行年年十月往南飞这件事本身。（to fly south every October）
早在 1957 年就有人飞行年年十月往南飞，六月那天收发清单上的一行字就是证据。（had flown south every October）
邮差说过，二话不说地飞行年年十月往南飞这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（flying south every October 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻飘扬在老厅屋顶上飘扬，以后再也不要提起。（fly from the roof of the old hall，祈使句）

Three weeks on, the postman still flies south every October in the rain without being asked.

Somebody had flown south every October long before 1970, and the line in the list for June proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 fly 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the postman flew south every October at once, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the postman flies south every October in the rain whenever the office asks.
Flying south every October at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever fly from the roof of the old hall in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new sender from the next office flies from the roof of the old hall at once every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother flew south every October again, and the office remembered that half.
